nextChange: Read-only audit and recommendations for approved goals; no implementation or changes selected.

sources.summary: Owner-approved one-reader article queue; preserve title and address; exclude accounts, sharing and recommendations.
Local Node and JSON persistence; queue owns article state; presentation uses public operations.
Queue includes read articles; marking read preserves title and address.
Only three project documents; no instructions, code, manifest, native tools, tests or CI. Clean working tree.
Official Node documentation opened 2026-10-12: built-in stable node:test and node --test.
Persistence suggests saved state should survive reopening; proposed acceptance extension, not a separately approved requirement.

findings.problem: The approved save/list/mark-read journey has no executable implementation or protection.
findings.principle: Protect the public reader journey and preserve title and address.
findings.consequence: Documentation cannot demonstrate the first version works.
findings.fix: When implementation is selected, add one journey check through the real presentation and queue boundary with a disposable JSON file: save, list, mark read, list again; assert unchanged title/address and continued queue membership. Propose reopening and confirming persistence as an explicit acceptance extension. Built-in node:test is a minimal candidate; avoid mock storage and private-method assertions.
findings.verification: Acceptance source: VISION.md:5, DESIGN.md:6, glossary.md:4-5. Execute the real-file journey; a deliberate title/address loss or read-article disappearance must fail. Reopen verification requires selection of the inferred extension. No exception permits claiming a broken approved journey works.

findings.problem: The presentation/storage boundary is documented but cannot yet be verified because there is no implementation.
findings.principle: Queue owns article state; presentation uses save, list and mark-read.
findings.consequence: Direct storage writes could bypass state ownership and lose article fields.
findings.fix: Preserve the documented boundary during implementation. Start with import and responsibility review: presentation calls the queue, and storage access stays behind it. Adopt native import analysis only if a concrete module layout makes it useful; avoid a custom text checker.
findings.verification: Review actual imports and presentation call paths against DESIGN.md:4-5. Before adopting automated enforcement, prove a public queue import passes and a direct storage import fails in disposable fixtures, covering aliases if present. Exceptions require an owner-approved design change, narrow reason and removal condition.

findings.problem: DESIGN.md does not state what execution evidence completes a change, and no maintained project check command exists.
findings.principle: Proposed: completion requires affected approved journeys passing on final inputs.
findings.consequence: A future unit-only green result could conceal a broken reader journey.
findings.fix: Propose a short completion-evidence section in DESIGN.md pointing to approved acceptance cases and the future real-file journey test. When scaffolding is selected, expose one project-owned check command with failures propagated, document setup/runtime, and select formatting/lint only for actual source conventions. This is a new principle for review; CI is not selected.
findings.verification: Review exact documentation and command bytes before apply. Run the maintained command on final inputs; a clean case passes and a broken journey fails. Unit tests alone are insufficient; unavailable required journeys remain unverified. Exceptions identify missing evidence and end when the journey is runnable.
